info.title: Peable API
info.description: The Peable payments API (Orbit): FairCoin and card payments, Checkout, Payment Links, Billing, Connect and Tax. Amounts are base-unit integer strings; instants are Unix seconds; every object carries `id`, `object` and `livemode`. Guides: https://docs.peable.to.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key with the same request answers the stored response for 24 hours (ADR 0014 D3). The SDK sends one on every POST.

oxyServiceToken.description: Your server's Oxy service token, minted from its application credential. `@peable.to/sdk` mints and refreshes it for you.

oxyUserSession.description: A signed-in Oxy user (the Peable app, an Oxy app acting for its user).

livemode.description: `true` in live mode, `false` in test mode.

metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs: at most 50 keys, keys ≤ 40 characters, values ≤ 500.

balance.description: SIGNED base units in `currency`: negative is credit the customer holds, positive is owed. Applied to the next invoice when it finalizes.

currency.description: The customer's billing currency, set by its first balance movement, subscription or invoice.

test_clock.description: The test clock (`clock_…`) it lives on; test mode only.

type.description: The broad class a caller branches on first.

code.description: The machine-readable reason (one of 108 documented at https://docs.peable.to/errors, or a card network's decline code on a `card_error`).

decline_code.description: A card issuer's decline reason, on a `card_error`.

param.description: The offending request field, in bracket notation (`metadata[order_id]`).

message.description: A human-readable message, for a developer.

request_id.description: The `Request-Id` of this response, for support.

payment_intent.description: On a `card_error` from a confirm or an invoice payment: the PaymentIntent, as it now is.

invoice.description: On a failed invoice payment: the invoice, as it now is.

refresh_url.description: On an expired onboarding link: where the seller gets a fresh one.

Error.description: Every non-2xx answer. The HTTP status and `error.type` identify the failure.

livemode.description: `true` in live mode, `false` in test mode.

anyOf.description: `cus_…`, or the Customer with `expand[]=customer`; `null` once detached.

metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs: at most 50 keys, keys ≤ 40 characters, values ≤ 500.
